**Pass 1 (X-axis):** Apply 1D DWT along the $x$-axis for all $y, z$.
This splits the volume into low-pass ($L_x$) and high-pass ($H_x$) components.
**Pass 2 (Y-axis):** Apply 1D DWT along the $y$-axis for all $x, z$ on the results of Pass 1.
This splits $L_x$ into $LL_{xy}$ and $H_x$ into $HL_{xy}$, and similarly for the other components.
**Pass 3 (Z-axis):** Apply 1D DWT along the $z$-axis for all $x, y$ on the results of Pass 2.
This splits each of the 4 intermediate subbands into two, yielding the 8 final subbands.
The approximation subband $LLL$ from level $j$ is used as the input for level $j+1$.
